sloka: भिक्षु रूपम् परित्यज्य वानरम् रूपम् आस्थितः ।पृष्टम् आरोप्य तौ वीरौ जगाम कपिकुङ्जरः ॥४-४-३४॥
transliteration: bhikṣu rūpam parityajya vānaram rūpam āsthitaḥ ।pṛṣṭam āropya tau vīrau jagāma kapikuṅjaraḥ ॥4-4-34॥

translations.english: Hanuman, who was an elephant among monkeys, gave up the guise of a mendicant, and assuming the form of the monkeys, lifted both the heroes on to his back and proceeded.
